flow_note_description: Choose an existing note to display on the canvas. Removing it from the canvas keeps the original note.
flow_tab_delete_description: This tab's layout and text annotations will be removed. Tasks, notes, and task relationships are kept.
error_flow_tab_not_found: This canvas tab no longer exists.
error_last_flow_tab_required: At least one canvas tab is required.
share_qr_failed: The invitation was created and its link is ready to copy, but the QR code could not be generated: {error}
share_disabled_invitation_approval_help: This invitation is disabled. The device can sync after you enable it.
share_connection_not_observed: No connection observed this session. Connect or sync to collect details.
layout_resize_hint: Drag to resize. Double-click to reset.
resource_usage_unavailable: Resource usage is unavailable right now.
mcp_description: Let AI tools on this computer read and update your boards through the Model Context Protocol. Only apps you add below can connect.
mcp_clients_empty: No apps yet. Add one to create its access token.
mcp_client_write: Allow adding columns and creating, editing, moving, archiving, and restoring tasks
mcp_client_remove_confirm: Remove {name}? It will no longer be able to connect.
mcp_token_regenerate_confirm: The current token for {name} stops working right away. Update the app with the new token.
mcp_token_saved_hint: You can open these settings again from the app's menu.
mcp_token_once_hint: Copy these settings now. Secure storage isn't available on this computer, so the token can't be shown again.
mcp_token_unavailable: This token can't be shown. Regenerate it to get a new one.
mcp_client_edit_description: Choose which boards this app can access and whether it can make changes.
mcp_connect_description: Add these settings to the app. Treat them like a password.
error_mcp_port_unavailable: That port is in use or not allowed. Choose another port.
settings_task_details_default_help: Applies to every board. You can still switch a board from the toolbar.
settings_notify_columns_help: Choose which columns in “{board}” send due notifications.
settings_notify_columns_no_board: Open a board to choose which of its columns send notifications.
settings_notify_columns_empty: This board has no columns yet.
mcp_client_all_boards: All boards, including ones added later
mcp_activity_description: The last 200 tool calls since Cardbe started. Arguments and results aren't recorded.
focus_dialog_description: Show cards from any board that match every condition below.
focus_delete_description: Only the conditions of this Focus are removed. Cards stay as they are.
focus_empty_description: Change the conditions to see more cards.
quick_switch_description: Jump to the home page, Notes, a Focus, or a board
focus_float_hint: Drag to move, double-click to open in Cardbe, right-click for more options
explorer_save_as_focus_hint: Create a Focus with these conditions
focus_from_explorer_partial: Some conditions, such as a column, a custom date range, or sorting by column, can’t be kept in a Focus and were left out.

match.count=*: You can create up to {countFormatted} Focuses.

desktop_widget_manager_description: Add and manage desktop widgets and floating windows in one place. They stay on this device and follow changes to their source.
desktop_widget_add_description: Choose what to show, then place it on the desktop or in a floating window.
desktop_widget_none: No widgets yet. Select Add Widget to create one.
desktop_widget_no_focus: Create a Focus in the sidebar first, then add it here as a widget.
desktop_widget_no_tasks: No matching tasks in this board.
desktop_widget_search_tasks: Find a task in this board
desktop_widget_added: Widget added. Switch to your desktop to see it.
daily_plan_help: Choose what you want to work on, even without a due date. Your list stays on this device until you remove items. Archived, deleted or transferred tasks leave the list.
daily_plan_empty: Nothing planned yet. Choose a few tasks for today.
daily_plan_limit: Your plan can contain up to {count} tasks.
daily_plan_subtitle: Set your own order. Unfinished tasks stay on your list.
daily_plan_picker_help: Choose tasks from any board. Click to add or remove; changes are saved automatically.
daily_plan_empty_title: Where would you like to start today?
daily_plan_float_empty: Add tasks to your plan from the home page.
deep_link_invalid: This link is invalid or unsupported.
enterprise_subtitle: A working foundation for managed team workspaces.
enterprise_scope: This console uses a separate local prototype service and SQLite test database.
enterprise_scope_limits: OIDC sign-in, PostgreSQL, desktop synchronization, offline queues and production deployment are not connected yet. Use synthetic test data.
enterprise_connect_help: Start the local service, then paste the development device token issued by the bootstrap command or an administrator.
enterprise_memory_only: Tokens and unsent drafts stay in memory for this tab only. Reloading or disconnecting clears them. Roles come from the service.
enterprise_no_boards: No readable boards in this workspace. An administrator can create a board or its manager can grant access.
enterprise_select_board: Select an accessible board to continue.
enterprise_viewer_help: Your board access is read-only. Creating tasks, editing and commenting require editor or manager access.
enterprise_pending_help: Retry sends exactly the same operation ID and content. Do not recreate the operation while its result is unknown. Pending retries are lost if this tab reloads.
enterprise_result_replayed: The service returned the saved result; no duplicate was created.
enterprise_assignee_help: The service verifies board access for each assignee. Organization members see themselves and any existing assignee; administrators can also use the member directory.
enterprise_task_version: Task version {version}; stale edits are rejected.
enterprise_create_member_help: Creates a real member record and first device token in the prototype database.
enterprise_create_device_help: Issue a separate token for another test browser or device. Revocation affects that device.
enterprise_revocation_help: Suspension and device revocation are checked on the next server request. Previously downloaded copies cannot be remotely erased.
enterprise_token_once: Copy this token now and handle it as a credential. It is only shown after issuance and is cleared when this dialog closes. The device remains registered.
enterprise_copy_failed: Clipboard access failed. Select and copy the token manually.
enterprise_confirm_member_action: Apply this access change to {name}? Changing your own access may disconnect this session.
enterprise_admin_uncertain: The management request may have succeeded. Refresh and inspect the records before submitting again. A lost token must be replaced by revoking that device and issuing a new one.
enterprise_access_help: Board access is independent of organization administration. The service verifies every change; this prototype does not yet provide an access-list endpoint.
enterprise_member_id_help: Copy the ID from the member list, or ask the member for the ID shown in their connected session.
enterprise_access_saved: The service saved this access change.
enterprise_manager_required: Only a manager of this board can change its access.
enterprise_audit_help: Persistent records from the service. Action names, IDs and outcomes are displayed as recorded for inspection.
enterprise_error_unauthenticated: This session is invalid, expired or revoked. Restricted data has been cleared. Connect with an active device token.
enterprise_error_permission: The service denied access. Restricted data has been cleared; reconnect after confirming your permissions.
enterprise_error_not_found: The requested resource was not found. Refresh the list.
enterprise_error_invalid: The service rejected an input. Check the required fields and IDs.
enterprise_error_conflict: This task changed after it was loaded. Reload and review the current version before revising your draft.
enterprise_error_idempotency: This operation ID was already used with different content. Do not retry it with a changed payload.
enterprise_error_last_manager: At least one active owner or board manager must remain. Complete the handover first.
enterprise_error_network: The service could not be reached or did not respond in time. A submitted operation may already have been accepted.
enterprise_error_internal: The service could not complete this request. No internal error details are displayed.
